entries.text: Slander and speaking lies about your brethren is an abomination to God.

text.text: These six things doth the Lord hate: yea, seven are an abomination unto him:
A false witness that speaketh lies, and he that soweth discord among brethren.

entries.text: You shall not go about speaking slander or spreading false reports about others.

text.text: Thou shalt not raise a false report: put not thine hand with the wicked to be an unrighteous witness.
Thou shalt not go up and down as a talebearer among thy people: neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbour: I am the Lord.
And the soldiers likewise demanded of him, saying, And what shall we do? And he said unto them, Do violence to no man, neither accuse any falsely; and be content with your wages.
The aged women likewise, that they be in behaviour as becometh holiness, not false accusers, not given to much wine, teachers of good things;

Speak not evil one of another, brethren. He that speaketh evil of his brother, and judgeth his brother, speaketh evil of the law, and judgeth the law: but if thou judge the law, thou art not a doer of the law, but a judge.
Lord, who shall abide in thy tabernacle? who shall dwell in thy holy hill?
Backbiters, haters of God, despiteful, proud, boasters, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,

For I fear, lest, when I come, I shall not find you such as I would, and that I shall be found unto you such as ye would not: lest there be debates, envyings, wraths, strifes, backbitings, whisperings, swellings, tumults:

entries.text: A backbiting tongue brings forth an angry countenance (no one will be pleased with a backbiter).

text.text: The north wind driveth away rain: so doth an angry countenance a backbiting tongue.

entries.text: A talebearer who spreads scandals causes harm to others.

text.text: The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.
Where no wood is, there the fire goeth out: so where there is no talebearer, the strife ceaseth.
The words of a talebearer are as wounds, and they go down into the innermost parts of the belly.

entries.text: He who does not backbite and slander with his tongue is near to God.

text.text: Lord, who shall abide in thy tabernacle? who shall dwell in thy holy hill?
He that walketh uprightly, and worketh righteousness, and speaketh the truth in his heart.
He that backbiteth not with his tongue, nor doeth evil to his neighbour, nor taketh up a reproach against his neighbour.

entries.text: We should not speak evil of someone out of suspicions or assumptions.

text.text: He is proud, knowing nothing, but doting about questions and strifes of words, whereof cometh envy, strife, railings, evil surmisings,

entries.text: Beware of those who are slanderers.

text.text: Without natural affection, trucebreakers, false accusers, incontinent, fierce, despisers of those that are good,

entries.text: Slander is a characteristic of the wicked.

text.text: For I have heard the slander of many: fear was on every side: while they took counsel together against me, they devised to take away my life.
But unto the wicked God saith, What hast thou to do to declare my statutes, or that thou shouldest take my covenant in thy mouth?
Thou sittest and speakest against thy brother; thou slanderest thine own mother’s son.
They are all grievous revolters, walking with slanders: they are brass and iron; they are all corrupters.

entries.text: Libel and name calling is condemned by Christ.

text.text: But I say unto you, That whosoever is angry with his brother without a cause shall be in danger of the judgment: and whosoever shall say to his brother, Raca, shall be in danger of the council: but whosoever shall say, Thou fool, shall be in danger of hell fire.

entries.text: He that speaks slander is a fool.

text.text: He that hideth hatred with lying lips, and he that uttereth a slander, is a fool.

entries.text: Those who indulge in slander are not to be trusted.

text.text: Take ye heed every one of his neighbour, and trust ye not in any brother: for every brother will utterly supplant, and every neighbour will walk with slanders.

entries.text: Slander is a sign of a debauched and corrupt people.

text.text: They are all grievous revolters, walking with slanders: they are brass and iron; they are all corrupters.
Take ye heed every one of his neighbour, and trust ye not in any brother: for every brother will utterly supplant, and every neighbour will walk with slanders.
In thee are men that carry tales to shed blood: and in thee they eat upon the mountains: in the midst of thee they commit lewdness.

entries.text: We are commanded to put away all such evil speaking.

text.text: Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from you, with all malice:
Wherefore laying aside all malice, and all guile, and hypocrisies, and envies, and all evil speakings,

entries.text: You shall not go about as a slanderer among your people.

text.text: Thou shalt not go up and down as a talebearer among thy people: neither shalt thou stand against the blood of thy neighbour: I am the Lord.

For I fear, lest, when I come, I shall not find you such as I would, and that I shall be found unto you such as ye would not: lest there be debates, envyings, wraths, strifes, backbitings, whisperings, swellings, tumults:

entries.text: You are to speak evil of no man.

text.text: To speak evil of no man, to be no brawlers, but gentle, shewing all meekness unto all men.

Speak not evil one of another, brethren. He that speaketh evil of his brother, and judgeth his brother, speaketh evil of the law, and judgeth the law: but if thou judge the law, thou art not a doer of the law, but a judge.

entries.text: He who secretly slanders his neighbor is to be cut off from the people.

text.text: Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour, him will I cut off: him that hath an high look and a proud heart will not I suffer.
